title: The cost of the last mile

revisions.content:
## Investment thesis
This fictional logistics company illustrates research on a capital-intensive operator. Study route density, utilization, and replacement spending before estimating normalized earnings.

## Risks
Fuel, labor costs, and low utilization may reduce operating leverage.

## Open questions
What percentage of capital spending simply maintains the existing network?

## Sources
Fictional demonstration. No verified source documents supplied.
